description: This file is a code-behind for an ASP.NET web page that manages the start exam process in an online examination system. It handles user session validation, populates course options based on the student's semester, and initiates the setup for theory or MCQ exams based on user selections. It also includes functions for navigation and checking if a user has already taken an exam.

classes.name: StartExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the StartExam.aspx page managing exam initiation logic.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event; validates session, loads student semester info, and populates course dropdown.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the user profile page.

methods.name: startB_Click
methods.description: Starts the selected exam (Theory or MCQ) after checking for question bank availability and setting session variables.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to login page.

methods.name: GridView1_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of theory exam from grid, checking if student already took the exam, and sets starting question number.

methods.name: GridView2_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of MCQ exam similar to theory exam logic.
